obligations.behavior: Arbitrate contending AR and AW/W requests per master output interface by highest effective 4-bit QoS with independent per-QoS-level round-robin tie-breaking not reset by higher-QoS grants, forward unmodified s_axi_*qos to m_axi_*qos, forward M_*_REG_TYPE in axi_crossbar, and preserve AW/W alignment and AXI4 handshake stability.
verified_by: private/tests/tb.sv (test_qos_ordering, test_per_level_rr_fairness, test_mid_stall_aw_w_alignment, continuous AXI4 stability monitor)

obligations.behavior: Disable ageing when AGEING_LIMIT == 0; when AGEING_LIMIT > 0, promote a pending ungranted contender on a master output interface to effective QoS 4'hF after AGEING_LIMIT grants on that interface go to other ports, preserving count across multi-beat W bursts.

Pause normal-QoS (< HIGH_QOS_MIN) slave admission when effective in-flight count >= S_ACCEPT - QOS_RESERVE while admitting high-QoS (>= HIGH_QOS_MIN) up to S_ACCEPT, and track DECERR transactions in in-flight counters and S_THREADS without underflow or same-ID reordering.
